notes.subject: pundaun long
notes.rationale: בעט i tok trample/kick — pasin bilong kirap leg na pundaun, ol man i save tok 'kick against'

notes.subject: kaikai tumas
notes.rationale: ברא long hia em i fatim bel — ol pris i kaikai ol bikpela hap bilong sakrifies

notes.subject: לעמי
notes.rationale: samting man i no klia: 'Israel, ol man bilong mi' o 'ol minkha bilong ol man bilong mi Yisrael'

notes.subject: to Eli
notes.rationale: Yahwe i toktok dairek long Eli, papa bilong ol pris

translation: Bilong wanem yu pundaun long ol sakrifies bilong mi na long ol minkha bilong mi, we mi bin givim tok long Miskan, na yu mekim bigpela nem bilong ⟨את⟩ ol pikinini bilong yu moa long mi, long yu yet i kaikai tumas wantaim ol — long stat bilong olgeta minkha bilong Yisrael, bilong ol man bilong mi?

tokens.gloss: na long ol minkha bilong mi
long yu yet i kaikai tumas
